news.title: Sidewalk closure north of Fairchild Hall starts on June 8
news.summary_en: Beginning Monday, June 8, a section of the sidewalk on the north side of Fairchild Hall, south of Mid-Campus Drive, will be temporarily closed to pedestrians.
